text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we pulled ~30 short voice clips from onboarding calls (Acme, SunRiver, NorthBay). Need to surface feature asks + pain points, tag by severity and renewal-risk. Can we get a shortlist for PM review by EOD tomorrow?

Ethan Patel: OK. Do we want an automated extraction (ask/pain/action) or a fast manual pass? What's the minimum useful output? :eyes:

Priya Reddy: I can run a first-pass. Plan: speaker diarization -> transcribe -> extract 1-sentence 'ask' + severity + renewal flag. Output CSV with columns. Minimal CSV header I'm going to use:
```
customer,clip_id,transcript,ask,severity,renewal_flag,notes
```

Luis Garcia: Suggestion for scoring/prioritization: score = frequency*2 + severity*3 + (renewal_flag ? 5 : 0). Normalize per-customer to avoid noisy accounts dominating. Also tag anything that is an 'enablement' ask (docs/training) separately.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Priya — can you push the CSV to the shared drive and ping the PMs? I'll prep the one-pager.

signal-bot: Uploaded file voiceclips_transcripts_1778912345.csv to Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/voiceclips_transcripts_1778912345 :file_folder:

Priya Reddy: CSV uploaded and ran a lightweight heuristic extractor. Sample rows below:
```
Acme,clip_03,"Transcript text here...","Allow per-route cost toggle","high",true,"mentioned during renewal call"
NorthBay,clip_12,"Transcript text here...","More visibility on token billing","medium",false,"requested in enablement session"
SunRiver,clip_07,"Transcript text here...","Support for private model pinning","high",true,"explicit ask from infra team"
```

Ethan Patel: Nice. Can we auto-open tickets for top 5 scores and tag with 'customer-voice' and 'renewal-risk' when the flag is true? Then PMs can triage. @Luis can you take ownership of the ticket template?

Maya Chen: Assigning follow-up: @Luis please review top 10 and mark 'must-fix' vs 'watch' — also indicate if enablement covers it. I'll loop in CS leads for context on renewal signals.

Luis Garcia: On it. Quick question — should enablement items go into product backlog or a separate enablement swimlane? Trying to avoid overloading product if it's purely docs/training.

Ethan Patel: Separate enablement swimlane preferred. Product backlog for product changes only. We'll surface cross-listed items to both where needed.

Maya Chen: Great. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll assemble the one-pager after Luis' review and send to PM + CS leads. If anyone hits blockers (drive access, missing transcripts) ping me directly.

Priya Reddy: FYI ran into 2 clips with poor audio — flagged them in notes. Might need manual listening for context.

signal-bot: Reminder: Weekly CS->Product sync in 2h. Agenda will include voice-clip prioritization summary.

Maya Chen: Cool — see you all in the sync.
